name: @w6w-apps/supadata
description: Fetch video transcripts and metadata, extract structured data from video, search YouTube, and scrape or crawl the web through Supadata.

w6w.longDescription:
Supadata turns videos and web pages into text. This app exposes its REST API to a workflow, authenticated with an API key.

A workflow can fetch the transcript of a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) or Facebook video, or of a public media file, falling back to AI transcription when no native transcript exists. It can read unified metadata for any of those posts, ask AI to extract structured data from a video with a prompt or JSON Schema, scrape a web page to Markdown, map a site's URLs, and crawl a whole site. For YouTube it can also search, read channels and playlists and their video ids, translate a transcript, and run batch jobs over many videos. Long-running work (generated transcripts, extraction, crawls and batches) is asynchronous: each has a start action that returns a job id and a matching action that polls it.

Every call spends credits from the account's monthly allowance; the Get Account action reads the plan and the credits used.
